g.text: Table 1-style comparison | 500 factual requests per task, cohort and model
Each cell: weighted F1 on valid replies, followed by valid replies / 500 requested
Factual accuracy does not establish counterfactual annotation accuracy or policy-value improvement.
Valid replies only; failed requests remain in the /500 denominator. Cohorts can overlap; their sample counts must not be added.
F1 bin boundaries: K 3.2, 5, 6; Na 118, 135, 152, 169. These are different from reward normal-range boundaries.
Sodium dosage has factual predictions, but no target-validation patients for OPE; its RMSE and paired t remain not estimable.
